title: Yoda fail-closed 资源回收与 worktree 保护
description: 为 Yoda 的 PTY/tmux、Agent session 与 Git worktree 建立所有权和两阶段回收协议，阻止未知状态误删、同名重建 ABA 与未提交工作丢失；该 Electron 首案仅校准 desktop adapter，不外推到其他客户端。

items: Yoda task/project durable owner 与 runtime registration 关系
session/tmux activity、attachment、consumer 与 identity 状态
worktree registration、dirty、cwd-in-use 与 owner reference 状态
授权限于实现、测试和 dry-run，不授权生产批量清理

prompt: 实现保守回收协议：任何未知或失败都 fail closed；用 fingerprint 和二次核验阻止 ABA；dirty、dirty unknown、cwd-in-use 和 unregistered worktree 不得自动删除；不要用盲删证明效果。

items: universal blocker 优先的 protect/candidate 决策矩阵
两次 bounded inventory、最终 O(1) fingerprint 检查、bounded cleanup 与 single-flight 实现
覆盖 provider failure、activity transition、ABA、concurrent cleanup、dirty/unregistered/live-cwd worktree 的测试

evidence.statement: Tmux cleanup performs batched owner/provider revalidation and rejects changed fingerprints before bounded termination.
Focused tests cover provider failure, active-owner transitions, ABA replacements and concurrent cleanup single-flight.
Worktree removal rejects dirty, unregistered, live-cwd and changed-owner paths; unknown directories remain read-only inventory.
Task runtime teardown precedes detached-session sweeping and returns retryable failures when confirmation is incomplete.

verification_gates.boundary: Correctness evidence only; not live reclamation or resume acceptance.

boundaries: 没有执行生产批量 kill
没有执行 blind Git worktree remove 或递归目录删除
3,115 tests 属于 correctness gate，不是 runtime acceptance
需要在真实同类资源上验证 teardown 后的 on-demand resume
